findings.clause: given conventions §Error codes rule 3 (checklist C11): 'never registers a second @ControllerAdvice for the shared codes (GlobalExceptionHandler owns VALIDATION_ERROR, ACCESS_DENIED, NOT_FOUND, CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION, DATA_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, …)'
findings.problem: The Error Catalog defines PTY-400-VALIDATION, PTY-401-UNAUTHENTICATED, PTY-403-FORBIDDEN and PTY-500-INTERNAL as PTY codes. SEC-BE maps an @PreAuthorize refusal to PTY-403-FORBIDDEN. The given handler answers bean-validation, authentication, access-denied and unexpected failures with its own shared codes, and the module may neither re-map them nor add a second advice. The @Version optimistic-lock failure (CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION) has no catalog row at all. As a result, the api-spec ErrorResponse pattern '^PTY-', the frontend STD routing and TCs such as TC-PTY-113, 167, 177 and 196 assert codes the platform will not emit.
findings.fix: [KNOWN ISSUE - APPROVE by Hesham 2026-10-29 after REVISE rounds; fix via gov.py feature] Keep as PTY catalog rows only the codes a PTY Domain or service throws: the rule rows, PTY-404-*-NOT-FOUND, PTY-404-LOOKUP-KEY-UNKNOWN, and PTY-403-FORBIDDEN only where the service throws it itself (the Address role check of ADR-PTY-039 §4). For framework-level 400, 401, 403, 409 (concurrent modification) and 500, state that GlobalExceptionHandler answers with its shared codes. Relax the ErrorResponse code pattern to allow them, and re-key the frontend STD routing and the affected TCs on those codes. Amend ADR-PTY-024.

findings.problem: REQ-PTY-076 and AC-PTY-085 assert that 'b2bCredit stays on'. PTY only answers the dependency question (API-PTY-037, TC-PTY-036). The capability-flag owner (OI-05, still OPEN) is the one that must refuse, and no platform-findings row records that obligation.
findings.fix: [KNOWN ISSUE - APPROVE by Hesham 2026-10-29 after REVISE rounds; fix via gov.py feature] Add an OPEN platform-findings row. Owner: the capability-flag owner (OI-05) or erp-core cu. Obligation: call API-PTY-037 or PtyPartyApi.b2bCreditSwitchOffDependency before switching b2bCredit off, and refuse with the RULE-PTY-024 message. Evidence: CON-PTY-019, AC-PTY-085. Reword the Then of AC-PTY-085 to PTY's observable result: dependentCustomerCount 4, switchOffAllowed false, the message and the next action returned.

findings.problem: creditLimit, saleAmount and the contributors' amounts are unbounded `number` values, while the columns are NUMERIC(18,3). An input of 10^15 or more, or one with more than 3 decimals, has no stated outcome: it ends as an undefined 500 or as silent rounding. No TC covers it.
findings.fix: [KNOWN ISSUE - APPROVE by Hesham 2026-10-29 after REVISE rounds; fix via gov.py feature] Add maximum 999999999999999.999 and at most 3 decimals to the credit and request amount schemas. State in API-PTY-017, 019, 035 and 036 that a larger value or a higher scale is refused as validation (the given shared code, per G1). Add one BOUNDARY TC per input kind, with a limit-value case and a one-above case.

findings.problem: The three OPEN CORE-GAP questions to erp-core are not rows of the PLATFORM FINDINGS register.
findings.fix: [KNOWN ISSUE - APPROVE by Hesham 2026-10-29 after REVISE rounds; fix via gov.py feature] Add three OPEN rows. Owner: erp-core. Evidence: each CORE-GAP file and the ADR that depends on it (ADR-PTY-037, 039, 040).

findings.problem: An Owner holding both PERM_PTY_CREDIT_OVERRIDE_CREATE and _UPDATE can approve a request they raised. No rule states whether this self-approval is allowed.
findings.fix: [KNOWN ISSUE - APPROVE by Hesham 2026-10-29 after REVISE rounds; fix via gov.py feature] Decide it in an ADR. If segregation is chosen, add a rule, a catalog row and a TC. Otherwise state explicitly that self-approval by an Owner is permitted in v1.
